description: On Sunday morning the braided supply hose to our dishwasher split while it was running. Water sprayed across the kitchen for about twenty minutes before we shut the valve. The laminate floor has lifted and the cabinet base under the sink is soaked.

During the storm on Tuesday night strong winds blew a large oak tree from our backyard onto the roof. It punched a hole above the back bedroom and rain came in through the hole onto the ceiling and carpet. The tree is still lying on the house.

While replacing the bathroom vanity the contractor found that the drain pipe under the sink has been dripping for what looks like many months. The subfloor underneath is rotten and there is black mold on the back of the cabinet and the wall.

After three days of heavy rain the Alder Creek behind our house overflowed its banks. About two feet of water came into the basement and ruined the furnace, the washer and dryer, and boxes of stored furniture.
Someone broke the side door of our detached garage overnight and took two mountain bikes and a cordless tool set. We reported it to the police the next morning and have the report number.

We were away visiting family for three weeks in January and turned the heating off to save money before we left. When we came back a pipe in the upstairs bathroom had frozen and burst, and water had come through the living room ceiling.

A pan of oil caught fire on the stove while I was cooking dinner. I put it out with the extinguisher, but the range hood and the cabinets above the stove are burnt and the whole kitchen is covered in smoke residue.
Our wedding caterer cancelled the day before the reception and has not returned the $2,400 deposit we paid. We had to book a different caterer at short notice for a higher price.

Heavy rain overnight and by morning the floor drain in our finished basement had backed up. There was about an inch of dirty water across the rec room carpet, and the drywall along the bottom of the walls is wet.

Our washing machine is in a closet off the hallway. We noticed a stain on the hallway floor about two weeks ago and thought it was spilled detergent. Yesterday the floorboards started to feel soft, and when we pulled the machine out the fitting behind it was dripping and the floor under it is dark and swollen.
